en.title: Justice Laws: repeated subparagraph labels in 8 places of the consolidated XML
en.summary: In 8 places of the consolidated Acts and regulations, a paragraph has two subparagraphs with the same label in one language version: Financial Institutions Depositors Compensation Act, 5(2)(b), English; Income Tax Act, 142.6(8)(b), French; Electronic Payments Regulations, 3(b), English; Transportation of Dangerous Goods Regulations, 5.10(1)(d), French; Proceeds of Crime (Money Laundering) and Terrorist Financing Regulations, 89(e), French; Canada Offshore Renewable Energy Regulations, 40(3)(e), French; Defence Services Pension Part V Regulations, 34(4)(b), French; Determination of Country of Origin for the Purpose of Marking Goods (CUSMA Countries) Regulations, 2(2)(b), French. The origin has not been established: the enacted or registered texts were not checked.
en.impact: A reference to the repeated label does not identify one subparagraph in that language version. No effect on how a provision applies has been established.
en.correction: Where the difference comes from the enacted or registered text, it needs an amendment by the responsible department; otherwise the consolidation can be corrected.

fr.title: Lois du Canada : numéros de sous-alinéas répétés à 8 endroits du XML codifié
fr.summary: À 8 endroits des lois et règlements codifiés, un alinéa compte deux sous-alinéas portant le même numéro dans une version linguistique, par exemple Loi de l’impôt sur le revenu, alinéa 142.6(8)b), version française : (iv), (iv), (v); Règlement sur le transport des marchandises dangereuses, alinéa 5.10(1)d) : « (v) la norme CSA B622, (iv) la norme CSA B625 ». L’origine n’est pas établie : les textes adoptés ou enregistrés n’ont pas été vérifiés.
